entries.title: Ancient human genomes suggest three ancestral populations for present-day Europeans
entries.quote: We sequenced the genomes of a ∼7,000-year-old farmer from Germany and eight ∼8,000-year-old hunter-gatherers from Luxembourg and Sweden.
entries.summary: 论文摘要确认该研究测序了来自卢森堡和瑞典、距今约八千年的狩猎采集者基因组。
entries.scope_note: 这条引文补充论文与样本的研究背景，不填补当前亲缘关系缺口。
